Trong nôi có chiếc trâm gỗ gãy. Hà bảo c: The cradle holds a broken wooden hairpin. Hà says a grown-up likely used it to rock the baby to sleep. I am not sure. I only see that someone left their own thing beside the child.
Chi chụp gương, trong ảnh hiện một bóng: Chi photographed the mirror; the picture shows a white shape by the bed, though to the naked eye no one is there. My back goes cold, and I fear I am forcing everything into a ghost story. I keep the photo for comparison.
Chiếc nôi tự khẽ đưa dù cửa không mở. Tr: The cradle rocks gently though the door has not opened. In it is a piece of half-embroidered cloth: “Nh…”. I hear a very small crying. I only dare write the first two letters, and will not name her myself.
Giấy khai sinh ghi Nhài sinh năm 1981, l: The birth certificate says Nhài was born in 1981, the child of Mr. Hưng and his wife; the line recording her disappearance on the night of 17/3/1988 has been struck out. She was only seven. I look at that number longer than at any other.
Một đôi dép vải nằm lại trong căn phòng: A pair of cloth sandals left in the sealed room. Hà said nothing, only sat down for a long while. I want to bring the belongings into the light together with the story of the one who wore them.
Dưới hầm có hộp giấy tờ cấp đồ lễ mang c: In the basement there is a box of papers for the issue of ritual offerings bearing Mr. Hưng's signature. At last there is something that is not only hearsay or a feeling. Looking at the original, my hands still shake.
Bà Tám viết rằng đêm 17/3/1988 bà nghe t: Mrs. Tám wrote that on the night of 17/3/1988 she heard cries for help from the basement but was too afraid to speak up. She kept her statement. I do not know whether, on that night, I would have had the courage.
Trong xô giếng có chiếc chuông đồng nhỏ: In the well bucket is a small bronze bell tied with red string, the kind tied to children lest they stray. Hà held it a long while. No one knows how long it had been down there.
Tớ chép lại đúng thứ tự bài đồng dao cô: I copied down in exact order the rhyme Ms. Quyên taught: doll, paper crane, wooden cart, white chalk. Whenever I think of a grown-up patiently teaching a child with those small things, something chafes in my chest.
Tờ giấy cô Quyên để lại ghép năm ký hiệu: The sheet Ms. Quyên left pairs five symbols with the servants' names: Giáp — pen, Thành — scales, Quyên — musical note, Nụ — fire, Bình — wave. Perhaps she wanted Nhài to remember the written forms by easy pictures.
Mặt sau ảnh có lời cô Quyên: người ký đơ: On the back of the photo is Ms. Quyên's note: those who signed the request stand in the order Giáp, Thành, Quyên, Nụ, Bình. The line “five people like five fingers” makes them feel close to me in a way that aches.
Đằng sau lớp gạch là cửa gỗ cũ. Then cài: Behind the brickwork is an old wooden door. The bar is on the outside; the inner face is covered in scratches. From the marks alone I cannot tell how long anyone was in here. But someone tried to open that door.
Trong hộp sắt là lời ông Hưng viết về Qu: In the iron box is what Mr. Hưng wrote about Quế and the night of 17/3/1988. It must be checked against the hour the door was locked, when he heard the story, and the other papers. I want to call it a confession, but I still have to read every line carefully.
Nhật ký ông Hưng ghi ông giấu chìa kho ở: Mr. Hưng's journal says he hid the storeroom key where he usually sat for the breeze, looking down at the village. He wrote that he did not dare open it. I do not understand how a person can know a thing is wrong and still live on for that many years.
Nhật ký cô Quyên ghi những chuyện nhỏ củ: Ms. Quyên's journal records small things about Nhài: meals, medicine, the time she had a fever. The last pages have been torn out. Even a few lines of caring for her are enough to make this house less like a ghost story.
Một bát cơm vẫn ấm trong phòng thờ, dưới: A bowl of rice still warm in the ancestral shrine room, and on the floor tiny footprints leading back to the kitchen. I know this is unreasonable. But Hà felt the heat, and Chi saw the footprints too.
Trong ký ức về đêm 17/3/1988, Nhài nghe: In the memory of the night of 17/3/1988, Nhài heard cries for help from the basement and ran to find someone. She carried something bronze and ran through the rain; the bell fell into the well. I must check the rest against the papers.
Ảnh Chi chụp ở giếng có hai bóng người,: Chi's photograph at the well shows two figures, one tall and one short. I dare not name them until I am sure. We still have to find more evidence.
Có lẽ cuối cùng mình đã tìm được tên ngư: Perhaps at last I have found the name of the person tied to this relic. I shall write it carefully and check it against the papers.
Bình, Nụ, Quyên, Thành, Giáp. Khi từng c: Bình, Nụ, Quyên, Thành, Giáp. As each name was spoken, the incense caught and the iron gate opened. I no longer know what to call it; I only feel lighter because I spoke their names rightly.
Bản sớ tạ rừng cũ ghi Huyền Lâm Thánh Qu: The old forest-thanksgiving petition names Huyền Lâm Thánh Quân and the line “The forest feeds the living, the living keep the forest green.” The hand and the seal are both old. I want to remember that line exactly.
Bản sớ kia có giấy mới chắp vào giấy cũ: The other petition has new paper patched onto old, and one line of darker ink, and the title is written Huyền Lâm Tôn Thần. Someone has altered it — but who, and to what end?
So hai bản sớ: danh hiệu đổi từ Thánh Qu: Comparing the two petitions: the title changed from Thánh Quân to Tôn Thần; new paper pasted over, the ink different; the line “The forest takes human blood” has been added. This is what is on the paper, not rumour.
Thư Quế gửi Tùng vạch rõ chuyện bản sớ b: Quế's letter to Tùng sets out plainly that the petition was swapped and tells him to run to the commune. Reading the line where she tells him not to come back, I had to set the paper down a while. Perhaps Quế knew she was in danger.
Ông Tùng kể chị Quế sinh năm 1971, hay h: Mr. Tùng says Quế was born in 1971, often gathered herbs and led lost strangers out of the forest. In 1986 she discovered that the petition Master Chân used had been altered. I want to test his account against the letter and the remaining petition.
Đến đây, chứng cứ cho thấy vụ Quế năm 19: By now the evidence shows the Quế case of 1986 and the imprisonment of 1988 are two different matters, both bound up with people concealing wrongdoing. Where it is unclear, I shall leave a blank rather than guess.
Bọn mình đã gọi tên Lành, Phúc và Mai ở: We spoke the names Lành, Phúc and Mai at the stone floor. I do not want to remember them only by how they died. First of all they were a family, they had ordinary meals.
Sau khi đối chiếu chứng cứ và hoàn tất v: Only after checking the evidence and finishing the work of restoring the names did we loosen the seal from the stone crevice. I do not want anyone to touch it out of mere curiosity.
At last the key fitted the lock. The door screeched. Vũ at once stepped back behind me, then pretended he meant to give way. There may still be papers from that year in the storeroom.
Dưới đệm ghế bập bênh có chìa đồng, đúng: Under the cushion of the rocking chair is a brass key, just where Mr. Hưng noted in his journal. The view down to the village from here is very far. How many nights did he sit in this spot and not dare open the storeroom?
Bà Tám để dành nhang mới cho những người: Mrs. Tám set aside new incense for those not yet called by their right names. So Nhài told me. I hold the bundle of incense and it feels heavier than the whole file.
Trong ngăn đồng hồ có mẩu giấy nhắc xem: In the clock compartment is a scrap of paper reminding me to look in the crack of the kitchen cupboard if I want the rest of the letter. I read it aloud to the group, then put it away carefully. At least this time there is a specific instruction.
Thầy Nguyên trao cho bọn mình cuốn Huyền: Master Nguyên gave us the Huyền Ấn Bí Lục – Trấn Âm Đồ. He said not to trust a story merely because it has been told a long time. I shall remember that, especially when the rumours in Đồng Chay keep contradicting one another.
Thầy Nguyên thừa nhận bút danh Lục Táng: Master Nguyên admitted the pen name Lục Táng is his. He kept Huyền Tĩnh's documents and stayed silent about his teacher taking money to imprison Mai. This time he promises to make everything public. I want to see him do it.
Ngay trước bàn lễ, ngọn đèn đang tắt bỗn: Just before the altar, the lamp that was going out suddenly caught. No one in the group touched it. Vũ stood motionless a while, no more jokes. I write it down because all five of us saw it.
Khi soi trang trắng của bí lục qua mặt n: When I held the blank page of the secret record over the water, characters appeared: “Find the mother by the blocked stream, the child beneath the banyan, and the son in the stone crevice. Speak the true names before you loosen the keeping thing.” I copied it word for word; I dare not change a single character.
Nhìn qua mặt nước thấy dưới ấn có nét ch: Looking through the water I saw lines beneath the seal pointing to the old stone floor. We have not lifted the seal. After what we have witnessed, I do not want to touch what I do not understand.
Trên cây có dải vải đỏ thêu tên bà ngoại: On the tree is a strip of red cloth embroidered with my grandmother's name. She really did come here. I stood a long time before that knot; suddenly I understood that there are apologies people never say aloud.
Bà Cúc đưa bản chép gia phả: bà Lành có: Mrs. Cúc gave us a copy of the genealogy: Mrs. Lành had two children, Mai and Phúc. Phúc once practised embroidering “Chị Mai” on a scarf; Mrs. Lành used the broken wooden comb. I circled those two details to check against the relics, not yet daring to conclude.
Tờ giấy bà ngoại để lại bảo chuyện năm 1: The paper my grandmother left says the matter of 1986 is true and that Quế was falsely accused. She told me to find Mr. Tùng, Quế's younger brother, at the east end of the hamlet; from the forest, take the right fork. If she knew, why did she not tell me plainly?
Ông Tùng nhớ lại lần chị Quế đưa giấy tờ: Mr. Tùng recalls the time Quế gave him the papers and urged him to run and call the grown-ups in 1986. Hearing him, I think of how we still call to one another whenever we are afraid. Only that day Tùng had to run alone.
Lược gỗ của Lành, khăn của Phúc, mảnh áo: Lành's wooden comb, Phúc's scarf, a scrap of Mai's clothing: the letters and the memories we found agree in places. I have set them side by side. As for who paid to imprison Mai, the signatures and records must still be checked.
Bọn mình đặt một bát cơm trắng cạnh di v: We set a bowl of white rice beside the relics on the stone floor. Not to call up any miracle; I only wanted that family to have one meal spoken of with kindness.
Cuối cùng cũng tách được hai mốc: vụ Quế: At last the two markers can be separated: the Quế case of 1986 and the imprisonment of 1988. I once gathered everything into one vague fear. Now at least I know they are two different events.
Dưới mâm gỗ ở miếu có mảnh giấy dó in bố: Under the wooden tray in the shrine is a slip of dó paper printed with four marks. The corner of the paper shows a marker post in the forest, with the line “Find the way home from the warmth to the shadow of the tree.” I do not understand it at once, but I feel I have missed something before my eyes.
Các dấu trên cột đá khớp với mảnh giấy d: The marks on the stone post match the dó paper. Set right, a small crevice opens. Vũ both whooped and snatched his hand back in fright. Rarely do I see him glad and afraid at once.
Chìa khóa sắt rỉ nằm trong khe cột mốc,: A rusty iron key lies in the crevice of the marker post, on the side facing the Vân Hòa gate. I keep it apart in my pocket; I do not want it mixed with the things picked up in the forest.
Đặt các di vật đúng chỗ, tiếng gõ dưới h: With the relics set in place, the knocking in the basement died away. Hà burst into tears, and I only felt drained. I cannot conclude from that silence that everyone has been set free.
Tiếng gõ vừa dứt thì từ tầng trên vang x: The knocking had barely stopped when a child's crying came down from upstairs. We have still left someone out. I was frightened enough to want to run, but I cannot pretend I did not hear.
Tên em là Nhài. Em mới bảy tuổi khi biến: Her name is Nhài. She was only seven when she disappeared in 1988, adopted by Mr. Hưng and his wife. At last we spoke her name rightly. For the first time that night, I felt how gentle a calling can be.
Hồ sơ cấp vật tư, ghi chép của ông Hưng: The supplies file, Mr. Hưng's notes and Mrs. Tám's account agree on the concealment of the truth. He says he was afraid, so he did not open the door. I have been afraid since I entered the house, but fear cannot stand in place of an explanation.
Bọn mình giữ lại bản sớ đáng ngờ để so v: We keep the suspect petition to compare with the original, and do not follow the chalk circles merely because someone wrote them. This time I want to understand what I am doing before I do it.
Mặt sau khung ảnh và bánh giải mã: Back of the photo frame and the cipher wheel
Bộ máy đồng hồ cũ với mặt đồng hồ điều c: Old clock movement with an adjustable dial
Click... There is an iron key in the crevice. It may fit the gate lock.
Có người giấu nó kỹ thật. Mảnh giấy ở mi: Someone hid it well indeed. The slip at the shrine led us here.
Khe đá đã mở. Mảnh giấy ở miếu và cột mố: The stone crevice has opened. The slip at the shrine and the marker post truly are connected.
Tiếng gõ đã lặng... Nhưng ai đang khóc t: The knocking has gone quiet... But who is crying on the second floor? A child.
Tiếng gõ đã lặng. Nhưng còn một người nữ: The knocking has stopped. But there is one more no one has named. I heard it clearly.
Phòng trẻ. Mình lên đó, nhưng đi cùng nh: The child's room. We go up, but together. No one stays behind alone.
Cảm ơn chị đã gọi tên em... Nhưng cha em: Thank you for speaking my name... But my father is waiting in the great hall. He will not let anyone carry the truth out of this house.
Chị đừng sợ. Bà vẫn luôn ở trong ngôi nh: Do not be afraid. Grandmother has always been in this house; she has never left.
Chị hứa. Em cứ yên tâm. Lần này sẽ có ng: I promise. Rest easy. This time someone will remember you.
Ký ức năm 1988 tiếp tục. Nhài vẫn ở tron: The memory of 1988 continues. Nhài is still inside that night.
Con nhớ rồi... mình đang tìm cách giúp m: I remember now... I am looking for a way to help everyone.
Hành trình tiếp tục. Những trang nhật ký: The journey continues. The journal pages still hold the clues you have found.
Tớ đã ghi lại hết rồi. Mình đi tiếp thôi: I have written it all down. Let us go on, but no one split from the group.
Mỗi nấm mộ đang chờ một cái tên. Hãy tiế: Each grave waits for a name. Keep searching the evidence and the records.
Các vật chứng và trang sổ đã tìm được có: The evidence and journal pages you have found may help call the names back.
